# mefa4: multivariate data handling with S4 classes and sparse matrices

[![CRAN
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/mefa4)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mefa4)
[![CRAN RStudio mirror
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/mefa4)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mefa4)
[![check](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/actions/workflows/check.yml)

An S4 update of the mefa package using sparse matrices for enhanced
efficiency. Sparse array-like objects are supported via lists of sparse
matrices.

- Main functions: `Xtab`, `Mefa`.
- Accessor and replacement functions: `xtab`, `samp`, `taxa`.
- Methods: `mbind`, `groupSums`, `groupMeans`.

See tutorial with design decisions and performance comparisons
([Rmd](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/blob/master/extras/mefa4.Rmd),
[PDF](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/raw/master/extras/mefa4.pdf))

## Versions

Install CRAN version as:

``` r

install.packages("mefa4")
```

Install development version from GitHub:

``` r

library(devtools)
install_github("psolymos/mefa4")
```

User visible changes are listed in the
[NEWS](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/blob/master/NEWS.md) file.

Previously hosted at
[R-Forge](https://r-forge.r-project.org/projects/mefa/) (until rev 619).

## Report a problem

Use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/psolymos/mefa4/issues) to
report a problem.
